            B 端多弹窗越来越难维护？试试把弹窗交互 Promise 化

                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><blockquote>
<p>作者： Kr1s Li｜灏仟亿前端技术团队</p>
</blockquote>
<p>在 B 端系统里，弹窗是很常见的交互形态：新增、编辑、详情、导入、审批、二次确认、权限提示，几乎每条业务链路都会遇到。弹窗少的时候，用几个 <code>visible</code> 状态就能解决；但当一个页面同时出现 3 个、5 个甚至更多弹窗，并且它们之间还有串行依赖时，问题就会变得明显。</p>
<p>真正麻烦的不是“怎么维护更多 visible”，而是弹窗交互经常被拆散在状态、回调、组件生命周期和请求逻辑之间。业务本来是一条连续流程，代码里却被切成了好几段。</p>
<p><code>render-promise</code> 想解决的就是这个问题：让一次弹窗交互像一次异步请求一样可等待。调用方只需要 <code>await openXxxModal()</code>，确认时继续向下走，取消时自然中断。</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/b240c8a31afa413399c1d98117dc4129~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54GP5Luf5Lq_5YmN56uv5oqA5pyv5Zui6Zif:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1789545067&amp;x-signature=JW3X1teoDilHjNqHKHsIFTBhvm4%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">1. 传统弹窗写法的问题</h2>
<p>在页面组件里提前实例化多个弹窗，是最常见的写法：</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/bd18cda2ce3040f098d03a9cc0974fc8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54GP5Luf5Lq_5YmN56uv5oqA5pyv5Zui6Zif:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1789545067&amp;x-signature=icWV%2BZfCtjIID33RhwjL12%2BNLsc%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/59b6e4fb23ed43aca2cda460c1df4dce~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54GP5Luf5Lq_5YmN56uv5oqA5pyv5Zui6Zif:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1789545067&amp;x-signature=bOTNpwt9ovw6cekpanpQoVf7JS8%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>通常会配套做几件事：</p>
<ul>
<li>在页面里提前挂载多个弹窗组件</li>
<li>每个弹窗维护一个 <code>visible</code> 状态</li>
<li>为每个弹窗写对应的 open / close 方法</li>
<li>在确认、取消回调里继续处理后续逻辑</li>
</ul>
<p>一个典型示意大概是这样：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>, { useCallback, useState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Button</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'antd'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">EditModal</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./EditModal'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DetailModal</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./DetailModal'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ConfirmModal</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./ConfirmModal'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Page</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [editVisible, setEditVisible] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [detailVisible, setDetailVisible] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [confirmVisible, setConfirmVisible] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [currentId, setCurrentId] = useState&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>&gt;();

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> openEdit = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">id: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">setCurrentId</span>(id);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">setEditVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);
  }, []);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> closeEdit = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setEditVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>), []);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> openDetail = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">id: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">setCurrentId</span>(id);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">setDetailVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);
  }, []);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> closeDetail = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setDetailVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>), []);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> openConfirm = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setConfirmVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>), []);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> closeConfirm = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setConfirmVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>), []);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onEditOk</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">closeEdit</span>();
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 可能还要刷新列表/再弹二次确认/再打开详情...</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">openConfirm</span>();
  };

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{()</span> =&gt;</span> openEdit('1001')}&gt;编辑<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Button</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{()</span> =&gt;</span> openDetail('1001')}&gt;详情<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Button</span>&gt;</span>

      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">EditModal</span> <span class="hljs-attr">open</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{editVisible}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{currentId}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{onEditOk}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClose</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{closeEdit}</span> /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">DetailModal</span> <span class="hljs-attr">open</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{detailVisible}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{currentId}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClose</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{closeDetail}</span> /&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">ConfirmModal</span> <span class="hljs-attr">open</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{confirmVisible}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{()</span> =&gt;</span> { closeConfirm(); }} onClose={closeConfirm} /&gt;
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>在弹窗数量少、流程简单时，这种写法没有问题。一旦弹窗数量增加，或者弹窗之间开始串联，维护成本会快速上升。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">状态会膨胀</h3>
<p>页面里会出现一排 <code>visibleXxx</code> 和一排 <code>setVisibleXxx</code>。即使后续尝试抽象成通用 open / close，也很容易引入更多分支参数，把管理逻辑继续复杂化。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">链路会被切碎</h3>
<p>典型场景是：先打开 A 弹窗，用户确认后触发校验或请求；校验通过后再打开 B 弹窗；B 弹窗确认后刷新列表或跳转页面。</p>
<p>这本来是一条完整业务链路，但在代码里往往会散落到页面组件、弹窗组件、请求函数，甚至多个文件里。代码能跑，但阅读和修改成本会越来越高。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">生命周期与业务意图不一致</h3>
<p>当 <code>visible=false</code> 时，组件通常只是隐藏，并没有卸载。这会带来两个问题：</p>
<ul>
<li>弹窗内部状态可能残留，下次打开还要手动 reset</li>
<li>弹窗即使没有真正打开，也可能在页面首次渲染时执行 effect 或加载依赖</li>
</ul>
<p>比如下面这个例子，弹窗没有打开，但组件已经被实例化，<code>useEffect</code> 仍然会执行：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>, { useEffect, useState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Modal</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Select</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'antd'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { queryEnums } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./api'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">EditModal</span>(<span class="hljs-params">props: { open: <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>; onClose: () =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> }</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [options, setOptions] = useState&lt;{ <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>; <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> }[]&gt;([]);

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 旧模式下：只要组件在页面根节点被实例化，这个 effect 就会执行</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 即便此时 open/visible 是 false，接口也会提前请求</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">queryEnums</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(setOptions);
  }, []);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Modal</span> <span class="hljs-attr">open</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{props.open}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onCancel</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{props.onClose}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{props.onClose}</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Select</span> <span class="hljs-attr">options</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{options}</span> /&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Modal</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>所以，这里真正要解决的不是“如何更优雅地维护 N 个 visible”，而是如何让弹窗交互的表达方式更贴近业务流程：从上到下可读，逻辑连续，边界清晰。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">2. 把弹窗看成一次可等待的决策</h2>
<p>从产品交互看，弹窗出现通常意味着用户需要完成一次决策。它通过遮罩暂时隔离主页面交互，让用户把注意力放在当前任务上。</p>
<p>弹窗打开之后，结果一般只有两类：</p>
<ul>
<li>用户确认：产生有效结果，例如提交表单、选择选项、确认操作</li>
<li>用户取消或关闭：不产生业务结果，当前流程中止或回到原流程</li>
</ul>
<p>这和 <code>Promise</code> 的语义很接近：确认对应 <code>resolve</code>，取消或关闭对应 <code>reject</code>。</p>
<p>如果“打开弹窗”可以被抽象成一个返回 Promise 的函数，业务层就能用 <code>await</code> 组织弹窗链路：等待 A 的结果，再决定是否进入 B；用户取消时，流程自然中断。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss"><span class="hljs-comment">// 业务层：像 await 一个异步函数一样 await 弹窗结果</span>
const flag = await <span class="hljs-built_in">aModalPromise</span>();
if (flag) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// refreshPageList()</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// or</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// navToXxxxPage()</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>这个思路看起来简单，但要真正落地，需要回答一个关键问题：</p>
<p>如果不再在页面 JSX 里提前实例化弹窗组件，弹窗到底渲染到哪里？它如何创建、如何卸载，又如何保证不会留下残余 DOM 或内存泄漏？</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-5">3. 核心机制：container / render / destroy</h2>
<p>函数式打开弹窗的关键机制，可以概括成三个词：<code>container</code>、<code>render</code>、<code>destroy</code>。</p>
<ul>
<li><code>container</code>：创建一个承载弹窗的 DOM 节点，通常挂在 <code>document.body</code> 下</li>
<li><code>render</code>：把弹窗组件渲染到这个节点里</li>
<li><code>destroy</code>：弹窗结束后卸载组件，移除容器节点，释放资源</li>
</ul>
<p>这种机制把“弹窗何时实例化、何时渲染、何时销毁”从页面组件里收敛出来。需要注意的是，像 Ant Design 的 Modal 本身也会通过 portal 把 DOM 插到 <code>body</code>，但传统写法里，组件实例是否存在、状态如何重置、effect 何时触发，仍然由页面侧的 <code>visible</code> 管理。</p>
<p>命令式渲染进一步把这些细节收进统一机制里：一次打开就是一次实例化，一次结束就是一次销毁。调用方不需要关心容器在哪里，也不需要管理卸载细节，只需要等待一个结果。</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/2e9fc80695db430b83f83387ada3aa52~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54GP5Luf5Lq_5YmN56uv5oqA5pyv5Zui6Zif:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1789545067&amp;x-signature=g99zui5X2dqaT9teU5hpXRihpDc%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-6">4. 从 Ant Design 的命令式 API 看这个机制</h2>
<p>日常使用 Ant Design 时，我们已经接触过不少命令式 API，比如 message、notification、confirm。调用方并不需要提前在页面 JSX 里放一个 <code>&lt;Message /&gt;</code> 或 <code>&lt;ConfirmModal /&gt;</code>，它们也能按需出现在界面上。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-less" lang="less"><span class="hljs-selector-tag">AntMessage</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.success</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'新增成功'</span>);
<span class="hljs-selector-tag">AntMessage</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.success</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'登录失败'</span>);

<span class="hljs-selector-tag">AntModal</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.confirm</span>({
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ...</span>
});
</code></pre>
<p>这类能力背后的模式通常也离不开“创建容器、渲染到容器、销毁并清理容器”。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 非某个 antd 版本的源码，只是与 antd 相同的机制示意</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">openLikeAntd</span>(<span class="hljs-params">
  renderIntoContainer: (el: any, container: HTMLElement) =&gt; <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span>,
  element: any,
</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> container = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'div'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">appendChild</span>(container);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">destroy</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode(container) 或 root.unmount()</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeChild</span>(container);
  }

  <span class="hljs-title function_">renderIntoContainer</span>(element, container);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { destroy };
}
</code></pre>
<p>再看 Ant Design v5.0.0 的 <code>components/modal/confirm.tsx</code>。下面保留与机制最相关的部分：</p>
<p>源码链接：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fant-design%2Fant-design%2Fblob%2F5.0.0%2Fcomponents%2Fmodal%2Fconfirm.tsx" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design/blob/5.0.0/components/modal/confirm.tsx" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">ant-design/ant-design@5.0.0/components/modal/confirm.tsx</a></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini">// Ant Design v5.0.0 - components/modal/confirm.tsx（节选，保留关键逻辑）
export default function confirm(config: ModalFuncProps) {
  const <span class="hljs-attr">container</span> = document.createDocumentFragment()<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  let <span class="hljs-attr">currentConfig</span> = { ...config, close, open: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> } as any<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>

  function destroy(...args: any<span class="hljs-section">[]</span>) {
    const <span class="hljs-attr">triggerCancel</span> = args.some(param =&gt; param &amp;&amp; param.triggerCancel)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    if (config.onCancel &amp;&amp; triggerCancel) {
      config.onCancel(() =&gt; {}, ...args.slice(1))<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    }
    for (let <span class="hljs-attr">i</span> = <span class="hljs-number">0</span><span class="hljs-comment">; i &lt; destroyFns.length; i++) {</span>
      const <span class="hljs-attr">fn</span> = destroyFns[i]<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
      if (<span class="hljs-attr">fn</span> === close) {
        destroyFns.splice(i, 1)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
        break<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
      }
    }
    reactUnmount(container)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  }

  function render({ okText, cancelText, prefixCls: customizePrefixCls, ...props }: any) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">timeoutId</span> = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
      const <span class="hljs-attr">runtimeLocale</span> = getConfirmLocale()<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
      const { getPrefixCls, getIconPrefixCls } = globalConfig()<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
      const <span class="hljs-attr">rootPrefixCls</span> = getPrefixCls(undefined, getRootPrefixCls())<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
      const <span class="hljs-attr">prefixCls</span> = customizePrefixCls || `<span class="hljs-variable">${rootPrefixCls}</span>-modal`<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
      const <span class="hljs-attr">iconPrefixCls</span> = getIconPrefixCls()<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
      reactRender(
        &lt;ConfirmDialog
          {...props}
          <span class="hljs-attr">prefixCls</span>={prefixCls}
          <span class="hljs-attr">rootPrefixCls</span>={rootPrefixCls}
          <span class="hljs-attr">iconPrefixCls</span>={iconPrefixCls}
          <span class="hljs-attr">okText</span>={okText}
          <span class="hljs-attr">locale</span>={runtimeLocale}
          <span class="hljs-attr">cancelText</span>={cancelText || runtimeLocale.cancelText}
        /&gt;,
        container,
      )<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    })<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  }

  function close(...args: any<span class="hljs-section">[]</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-attr">currentConfig</span> = {
      ...currentConfig,
      open: false,
      afterClose: () =&gt; {
        if (typeof <span class="hljs-attr">config.afterClose</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'function'</span>) {
          config.afterClose()<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
        }
        destroy.apply(this, args)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
      },
    }<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    if (currentConfig.visible) delete currentConfig.visible<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    render(currentConfig)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  }

  function update(configUpdate: ConfigUpdate) {
    <span class="hljs-attr">currentConfig</span> = typeof configUpdate === <span class="hljs-string">'function'</span>
      ? configUpdate(currentConfig)
      : { ...currentConfig, ...configUpdate }<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
    render(currentConfig)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  }

  render(currentConfig)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  destroyFns.push(close)<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  return { destroy: close, update }<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>这段源码里有三个重点：</p>
<ol>
<li><code>container = document.createDocumentFragment()</code>：创建承载节点</li>
<li><code>reactRender(..., container)</code>：命令式渲染</li>
<li><code>destroyFns.push(close)</code> 和 <code>reactUnmount(container)</code>：集中管理关闭与卸载</li>
</ol>
<p>调用侧不关心容器，只拿到一个可销毁句柄；渲染与销毁逻辑被集中管理，这就是命令式 UI 能够稳定运行的关键。</p>
<p>回到 <code>render-promise</code>，它做的是把这套机制再往前推一步：让“弹窗结束”与 Promise 的 <code>resolve/reject</code> 绑定，从而把业务链路写顺。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">5. render-promise 的源码设计</h2>
<p><code>render-promise</code> 可以按职责拆成两层：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Render</code>：负责容器生命周期，包括创建、渲染、卸载、销毁</li>
<li><code>renderPromise</code>：把一个组件包装成 Promise，并注入 <code>onOk/onClose</code>，同时提供 cleanup 兜底</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d2a0295b670f4db8ac45bffaa8c5b727~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54GP5Luf5Lq_5YmN56uv5oqA5pyv5Zui6Zif:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1789545067&amp;x-signature=ZoJiisLEQEExPLVNVfI0WctWu8s%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">5.1 Render：管理容器生命周期</h3>
<p>容器生命周期里最重要的一点是：无论卸载是否成功，都要保证容器被移除。这样才能避免残留 DOM，也能降低长期运行下的内存风险。</p>
<p>下面是 <code>render-promise</code> 中 <code>Render</code> 的关键逻辑摘取：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-kotlin" lang="kotlin"><span class="hljs-comment">// src/render-special.ts（节选）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Render</span> {
  create() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.div = document.createElement(<span class="hljs-string">'div'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.div.setAttribute(<span class="hljs-string">'tool-element'</span>, <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.name);
    document.body.appendChild(<span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.div);
  }

  render(element: JSX.Element) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> container = <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.ensureContainer();
    <span class="hljs-comment">// React 18 优先 createRoot，否则 fallback ReactDom.render</span>
    ReactDom.render(element, container);
  }

  unmountComponentAtNode() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> container = <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.div;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!container) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      ReactDom.unmountComponentAtNode(container);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.remove(); <span class="hljs-comment">// finally 清理 DOM 容器</span>
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>这里的设计重点不是代码量，而是生命周期边界清楚：创建容器、渲染组件、卸载组件、移除容器，每一步都有明确归属。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">5.2 renderPromise：把组件包装成 Promise</h3>
<p><code>renderPromise</code> 接收一个内部组件 <code>InnerComponent</code>，返回一个函数。业务调用这个函数时，会得到一个 Promise。</p>
<p>它主要做三件事：</p>
<ol>
<li>创建 host，也就是一个 <code>Render</code> 实例，用于完成命令式渲染</li>
<li>注入 <code>onOk</code> 和 <code>onClose</code>：<code>onOk</code> 时 resolve，<code>onClose</code> 时 reject</li>
<li>提供 <code>cleanup()</code> 兜底：确保卸载逻辑只执行一次，渲染失败时也能回收资源</li>
</ol>
<p>其中 <code>cleanup + 幂等开关</code> 是稳定性的重要来源。所谓幂等，就是同一个操作重复执行多次，最终结果与执行一次一致。放在这里就是：无论 <code>cleanup()</code> 被调用 1 次还是 3 次，最后都只会发生一次卸载和移除，不会因为重复清理导致异常。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// src/render-promise.tsx（接近完整实现，便于理解整体结构）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Render</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./render-special'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Options</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">ResolveValue</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./type'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { normalizeResolvePayload } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./utils'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> renderPromise&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">InnerProps</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>&gt;&gt;(
  <span class="hljs-title class_">InnerComponent</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ComponentType</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">InnerProps</span>&gt;,
  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>,
  options?: <span class="hljs-title class_">Options</span>,
) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RecordProps</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Omit</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">InnerProps</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'onOk'</span> | <span class="hljs-string">'onClose'</span>&gt;;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> (<span class="hljs-params">props?: RecordProps</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">host</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Render</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Render</span>(name, options);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> cleaned = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PromiseResolveType</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">ResolveValue</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">InnerProps</span>[<span class="hljs-string">'onOk'</span>]&gt;;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">cleanup</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (cleaned) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 幂等开关：只清理一次</span>
      cleaned = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
      host?.<span class="hljs-title function_">unmountComponentAtNode</span>();
      host = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
    };

    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">PromiseResolveType</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">resolve, reject</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> _props = (props ?? {}) <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">InnerProps</span>;

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleOk</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">...args: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>[]</span>) =&gt; {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">cleanup</span>();
        <span class="hljs-title function_">resolve</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">normalizeResolvePayload</span>(args) <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PromiseResolveType</span>);
      };

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleClose</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">reason: <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span></span>) =&gt; {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">cleanup</span>();
        <span class="hljs-title function_">reject</span>(reason);
      };

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> element = (
        <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">InnerComponent</span> {<span class="hljs-attr">..._props</span>} <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{handleOk}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClose</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{handleClose}</span> /&gt;</span></span>
      );

      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!host) {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">reject</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Failed to create render instance'</span>));
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      }

      <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
        host.<span class="hljs-title function_">render</span>(element);
      } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (error) {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">cleanup</span>();
        <span class="hljs-title function_">reject</span>(error);
      }
    });
  };
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> renderPromise;
</code></pre>
<p>到这里，<code>renderPromise</code> 已经把“容器机制”和“Promise 语义”合在了一起。组件负责在合适的时候触发 <code>onOk</code> 或 <code>onClose</code>，调用方只关心 <code>await</code> 的结果。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">5.3 类型与 payload 归一化</h3>
<p>为了让调用体验更自然，<code>renderPromise</code> 还处理了返回值类型。</p>
<p>它会把 <code>onOk</code> 的入参推导为 Promise resolve 的返回值类型。这样业务侧 <code>await openXxx()</code> 后，可以拿到更清晰的类型提示。</p>
<p>同时，<code>onOk</code> 可能不传参、传一个参或传多个参，所以内部会对 resolve 参数做归一化：</p>
<ul>
<li>0 个参数：返回 <code>undefined</code></li>
<li>1 个参数：返回该参数</li>
<li>多个参数：返回数组</li>
</ul>
<p>相关类型推导与归一化逻辑如下：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// src/type.d.ts（节选）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ResolveValue</span>&lt;T&gt; = <span class="hljs-title class_">NonNullable</span>&lt;T&gt; <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> (...<span class="hljs-attr">args</span>: infer <span class="hljs-title class_">Args</span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>
  ? <span class="hljs-title class_">Args</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> []
    ? <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>
    : <span class="hljs-title class_">Args</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> [infer <span class="hljs-title class_">OnlyArg</span>]
    ? <span class="hljs-title class_">OnlyArg</span>
    : <span class="hljs-title class_">Args</span>
  : <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
</code></pre>

<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini">// src/utils.ts（节选）
export const <span class="hljs-attr">normalizeResolvePayload</span> = (args: unknown[]) =&gt; {
  if (<span class="hljs-attr">args.length</span> === <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) return undefined<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  if (<span class="hljs-attr">args.length</span> === <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) return args[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
  return args<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
}<span class="hljs-comment">;</span>
</code></pre>
<p>这些细节看起来不大，但会直接影响业务侧写法是否顺手。类型和返回值形态稳定，调用方就不需要在每个弹窗结果上额外做一层兼容。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-11">6. 它在业务里带来的四类收益</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">6.1 状态天然清理：关闭即卸载</h3>
<p>传统 <code>visible=false</code> 模式通常只是隐藏组件，不一定卸载组件。弹窗内部状态可能残留，下一次打开还要手动 reset。</p>
<p>旧方案里经常要写这样的清理逻辑：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">const closeEdit = () =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-built_in">setEditVisible</span>(false);
  <span class="hljs-built_in">setFormValue</span>(DEFAULT_VALUE); <span class="hljs-comment">// 手动清理</span>
  <span class="hljs-built_in">setOptions</span>([]);              <span class="hljs-comment">// 手动清理</span>
};
</code></pre>
<p>而命令式创建与销毁的方式，会让组件在关闭时自然卸载，内部 state 随组件卸载释放：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">await <span class="hljs-built_in">openEditModal</span>({ id }); <span class="hljs-comment">// 关闭后组件被卸载，state 不会残留到下一次打开</span>
</code></pre>
<p>这不代表所有清理逻辑都能消失，但至少可以减少“每个弹窗都要写一套 reset”的维护负担。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-13">6.2 链路更连续：业务流程从上到下表达</h3>
<p>弹窗 Promise 化之后，业务层可以用 <code>await</code> 组织交互：先等待 A 的结果，再决定下一步。链路不会被回调切碎，阅读时更像一段完整业务流程。</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/94bb8707f4254d86a19b783eee698c8a~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54GP5Luf5Lq_5YmN56uv5oqA5pyv5Zui6Zif:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1789545067&amp;x-signature=4PEp43RqTjxqvQdlRAuakojw89E%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>旧方案里，回调与 <code>visible</code> 经常交织在一起：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// =========================</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// Page.tsx</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// =========================</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>, { useCallback, useState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Button</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'antd'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AModal</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./AModal'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BModal</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./BModal'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Page</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [aVisible, setAVisible] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [bVisible, setBVisible] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [id, setId] = useState&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>&gt;();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [aResult, setAResult] = useState&lt;{ <span class="hljs-attr">token</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> } | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> openAModal = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">nextId: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">setId</span>(nextId);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">setAVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);
  }, []);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> closeAModal = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setAVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>), []);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> openBModal = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setBVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>), []);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> closeBModal = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setBVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>), []);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> refreshList = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ...刷新列表</span>
  }, []);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{()</span> =&gt;</span> openAModal('1001')}&gt;开始流程<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Button</span>&gt;</span>

      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">AModal</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">open</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{aVisible}</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{id}</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">onClose</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{closeAModal}</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{async</span> (<span class="hljs-attr">res</span>) =&gt;</span> {
          // A 弹窗确认：先关 A，再决定开 B
          closeAModal();
          setAResult(res);
          openBModal();
        }}
      /&gt;

      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">BModal</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">open</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{bVisible}</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">token</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{aResult?.token}</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">onClose</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{closeBModal}</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{async</span> () =&gt;</span> {
          // B 弹窗确认：先关 B，再刷新页面数据
          closeBModal();
          await refreshList();
        }}
      /&gt;
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/&gt;</span></span>
  );
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// =========================</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// AModal.tsx</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// =========================</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>, { useCallback, useState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Modal</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'antd'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { preCheck } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./api'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">AModal</span>(<span class="hljs-params">props: {
  open: <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>;
  id?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  onClose: () =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  onOk: (res: { token: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> }) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
}</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [loading, setLoading] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> handleOk = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">setLoading</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// A 弹窗内部：做前置校验 / 请求</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> token = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">preCheck</span>(props.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>);
      props.<span class="hljs-title function_">onOk</span>({ token }); <span class="hljs-comment">// 把结果抛回 Page</span>
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">setLoading</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
    }
  }, [props]);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Modal</span> <span class="hljs-attr">open</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{props.open}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">confirmLoading</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{loading}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{handleOk}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onCancel</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{props.onClose}</span>&gt;</span>
      A 弹窗内容
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Modal</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// =========================</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// BModal.tsx</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// =========================</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>, { useCallback } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Modal</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'antd'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">BModal</span>(<span class="hljs-params">props: {
  open: <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>;
  token?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  onClose: () =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  onOk: () =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
}</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> handleOk = <span class="hljs-title function_">useCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// B 弹窗内部：可能还要处理提交/确认</span>
    props.<span class="hljs-title function_">onOk</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 最终还是回到 Page 去刷新/跳转</span>
  }, [props]);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Modal</span> <span class="hljs-attr">open</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{props.open}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{handleOk}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onCancel</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{props.onClose}</span>&gt;</span>
      B 弹窗内容（token={String(props.token)})
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Modal</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>改成 Promise 化之后，链路会收敛很多：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-csharp" lang="csharp"><span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> aResult = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> openAModal({ id });
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bResult = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> openBModal({ aResult });
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> refreshList(bResult);
} <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (e) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 用户取消/关闭，链路自然中断</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>在更复杂的流程里，也可以保持从上到下的阅读顺序：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-csharp" lang="csharp"><span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> function <span class="hljs-title">onClick</span>()</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> preCheck();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> openConfirmModal({ text: <span class="hljs-string">'确认要执行吗？'</span> });
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> result = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> openProgressModal({ taskId: <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> startTask() });
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> openResultModal({ result });
}
</code></pre>
<p>对团队协作来说，这一点往往比“少写几行代码”更重要。入口清晰、链路连续，维护者才能更快定位问题，也更容易判断改动影响。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">6.3 初始化更合理：按需引入弹窗模块</h3>
<p>弹窗以函数式打开的形态存在后，更容易做按需引入：业务触发时再加载相关模块，而不是页面初始化时就把所有弹窗组件和依赖都引进来。</p>
<p>旧写法通常在页面初始化时就 import：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 旧：页面初始化就 import 进来（弹窗依赖也会跟着进 bundle）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { openBigModal } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./big-modal'</span>;
</code></pre>
<p>新写法可以在真正需要时再加载：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 新：按需 import（业务触发时再加载弹窗模块）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">openBigModal</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params">props: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mod = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'./big-modal'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> mod.<span class="hljs-title function_">openBigModal</span>(props);
};
</code></pre>
<p>这是否能带来明显的性能收益，取决于页面规模和弹窗复杂度。但从工程结构上，它提供了更合理的拆分方式，也减少了首屏加载时并不需要的弹窗逻辑。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-15">6.4 不只适用于 Modal</h3>
<p><code>renderPromise</code> 的核心是“命令式渲染一个 React 节点，并在结束时销毁”，所以它并不限定只能用于 Modal。</p>
<p>如果某个固定定位的提示块、临时操作面板或轻量交互层也需要“可等待/可关闭”的能力，同样可以用这套机制。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> renderPromise <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'render-promise'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FixedTipProps</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">onClose</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">FixedTip</span>(<span class="hljs-params">props: FixedTipProps</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">style</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{{</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">position:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">fixed</span>',
        <span class="hljs-attr">top:</span> <span class="hljs-attr">20</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">left:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">50</span>%',
        <span class="hljs-attr">transform:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">translateX</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">-50</span>%)',
        <span class="hljs-attr">padding:</span> <span class="hljs-attr">12</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">borderRadius:</span> <span class="hljs-attr">8</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">background:</span> '#<span class="hljs-attr">111</span>',
        <span class="hljs-attr">color:</span> '#<span class="hljs-attr">fff</span>',
        <span class="hljs-attr">zIndex:</span> <span class="hljs-attr">9999</span>,
      }}
      <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{()</span> =&gt;</span> props.onOk()}
    &gt;
      {props.text}（点我关闭）
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> openFixedTip = <span class="hljs-title function_">renderPromise</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">FixedTip</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'fixed-tip'</span>);
</code></pre>
<p>业务侧调用：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-arduino" lang="arduino"><span class="hljs-function">await <span class="hljs-title">openFixedTip</span><span class="hljs-params">({ text: <span class="hljs-string">'保存成功'</span> })</span></span>;
</code></pre>
<p>只要交互符合“打开、等待结果、结束后销毁”这条链路，它就可以使用类似抽象。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-16">7. 一个最小闭环示例</h2>
<p>下面用 README 式示例看一下完整写法。</p>
<p><code>my-modal.tsx</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">React</span>, { useEffect, useState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">Modal</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'antd'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> renderPromise <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'render-promise'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MyModalProps</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">payload: { id: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> }</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">onClose</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">reason?: <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span></span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">MyModal</span>(<span class="hljs-params">props: MyModalProps</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [loading, setLoading] = <span class="hljs-title function_">useState</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);

  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 弹窗真正被打开时才会触发（因为组件此时才会被渲染）</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ...fetch detail by props.id</span>
  }, [props.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>]);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Modal</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">open</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">confirmLoading</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{loading}</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">title</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"示例弹窗"</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">onOk</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{()</span> =&gt;</span> props.onOk({ id: props.id })}
      onCancel={() =&gt; props.onClose('cancel')}
    &gt;
      这里是内容
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Modal</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> openMyModal = <span class="hljs-title function_">renderPromise</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">MyModal</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'my-modal'</span>);
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MyModal</span>;
</code></pre>
<p><code>page.tsx</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-csharp" lang="csharp">import React <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
import { Button } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'antd'</span>;
import { openMyModal } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./my-modal'</span>;

<span class="hljs-function">export <span class="hljs-literal">default</span> function <span class="hljs-title">Page</span>()</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    &lt;Button
      onClick={<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> openMyModal({ id: <span class="hljs-string">'1001'</span> });
          <span class="hljs-comment">// res 有类型提示（由 onOk 的入参推导）</span>
          console.log(res.id);
          <span class="hljs-comment">// ...refresh</span>
        } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (e) {
          <span class="hljs-comment">// 用户取消/关闭</span>
        }
      }}
    &gt;
      打开弹窗
    &lt;/Button&gt;
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>这个例子里，页面不再维护 <code>visible</code>，也不需要提前挂载弹窗。弹窗只在调用 <code>openMyModal</code> 时创建，结束后销毁。调用方通过 <code>await</code> 拿到结果，取消则进入 <code>catch</code>。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-17">8. 落地时建议统一三条规范</h2>
<p>如果团队希望在业务中长期使用类似能力，最好先形成一致写法。</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/9487ff975c3748ec91dc9fc4f05f1cad~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54GP5Luf5Lq_5YmN56uv5oqA5pyv5Zui6Zif:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1789545067&amp;x-signature=HDaEz7lFxD37Xj2hGyNu3q%2FYbGk%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>第一，弹窗组件统一接收 <code>onOk</code> 与 <code>onClose</code>。弹窗内部决定何时触发 resolve / reject，调用方不再维护 <code>visible</code>。</p>
<p>第二，统一导出 open 函数，例如 <code>openXxx = renderPromise(XxxModal, 'xxx')</code>。创建、渲染、销毁机制都封装在 open 函数内部。</p>
<p>第三，业务层只关心 <code>await openXxx()</code> 的结果，并据此组织后续流程。取消或关闭统一进入 <code>catch</code>，如果业务需要区分原因，再约定 reason 的形态。</p>
<p>reason 的处理方式可以简单分成两类。</p>
<p>统一把 reject 当作取消或关闭，不做细分：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-arduino" lang="arduino"><span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
  <span class="hljs-function">await <span class="hljs-title">openMyModal</span><span class="hljs-params">({ id })</span></span>;
} <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ignore</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>或者按 reason 分流：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">openMyModal</span>({ id });
} <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (reason) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (reason === <span class="hljs-string">'cancel'</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 其他异常：上报或提示</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(reason);
}
</code></pre>
<p>选哪种写法不取决于工具，而取决于团队对交互边界的约定。重要的是保持一致，不要在不同页面里混用多套语义。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-18">9. 总结</h2>
<p><code>render-promise</code> 解决的不是“弹窗能不能打开”，而是“弹窗交互如何以更接近业务流程的方式表达”。</p>
<p>它背后的机制并不复杂：<code>container / render / destroy</code>，再加上 Promise 的 <code>resolve/reject</code> 语义，以及工程上的 cleanup 兜底和类型归一化。</p>
<p>当一个页面只有一两个简单弹窗时，传统 <code>visible</code> 写法依然够用。但当弹窗开始串联、状态开始膨胀、回调链路开始散落时，把弹窗抽象成一个可等待的交互，会让业务代码更连续，也更容易维护。</p>
<p>更重要的是，这种方式提醒我们先看清交互本质：一次弹窗就是一次等待用户决策的过程。抽象对了，实现反而会变小。</p></div></div>
